item.title: Saudi VAT Return Spreadsheet: Sales and Purchases Ledgers (Excel)
item.description: Saudi VAT return spreadsheet with sales and purchases ledgers that roll into ZATCA return-style sections, plus pre-filing checks. Arabic + English, Excel and Google Sheets. You still file on zatca.gov.sa. Not tax advice. Start with the free threshold monitor in the same shop if you only need registration distance. I'm the author.
